mappings.note: What Rabindra Sangeet is: knowledge of the poet's body of work as a form. Neither LO-4 nor LO-5 reaches outside the prescribed poem, so the literature competency is the honest level.
The prize Tagore won as the first Indian (the Nobel): poet biography, cited at competency level for the same reason as qid:104180.
What the poet wishes to do in days of happiness: direct comprehension of the poem, LO-4.
What the poet does NOT ask of God: comprehension of the prayer's negative side, LO-4.
The style of Tagore's poetry: कला-पक्ष, LO-5, not the sense of any single line.

What we do besides praying to get our wishes fulfilled: a personal-response question that steps outside the text. C-H2.1 is the competency whose description includes 'उस पर प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त करना'; this frame has no LO for a reflective response.
Which रस predominates: a कला-पक्ष question, LO-5, not comprehension of content.
What the poet wishes to bear himself: comprehension of the self-reliance theme as stated, LO-4.
With whose help the poet wishes to face danger (his own strength): comprehension, LO-4.
What the poet prays should not waver (his faith): comprehension of the prayer's content, LO-4.
What the poet wishes to conquer: comprehension of a stated wish, LO-4.
What the poet says in his prayer to God: comprehension of the poem's substance, LO-4.
Which भाव Tagore's poetry expresses: the भाव-पक्ष half of LO-5, not a factual comprehension point.
The poem's original language (Bengali): background knowledge about the text as a translated work, so the literature competency rather than काव्यबोध.
Duplicate stem of qid:104182; what the poet wants in days of happiness, LO-4.

An MCQ stem to be completed by its options ('when surrounded by sorrow and cheated by people ...'): comprehension of the poem's situation, LO-4. The stem reads as a fragment only because the options are not printed by the context tool.
The आशय of 'निखिल मही' deceiving him: expounding the sense of a phrase, so भाव-पक्ष व्याख्या, LO-5.
The आशय of 'नत शिर होकर सुख के दिन में': phrase exposition, LO-5, as with qid:104197.
Why the poet does not want consolation from God: comprehension of the poem's stated stance, LO-4. Contrast qid:104197, which asks the sense of a phrase.
What the poet prays for: comprehension, LO-4.
In what circumstance the poet refuses to admit defeat, quoting 'तो भी मन में ना मानूँ क्षय': the item asks the situation, which is comprehension, not the exposition of the line.
Meaning of 'अनामय': word-meaning comprehension within the poem, LO-4.
The poem's central note (self-reliance rather than escape from suffering): the भाव-पक्ष of the whole poem, LO-5.
What the poet wants when calamity strikes: comprehension of a stated wish, LO-4.
